text:
maria: Quick heads-up — PR #27654 is ready for landing but CI queue is long. We have a staggered merge window at 18:00 UTC today. Can someone take merge-owner and handle the rebase + quick smoke? cc @jake @emily :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jake: I can own it if I'm back from oncall by 17:30 UTC. Will try to rebase at 17:20 and kick CI. What's the current blocker?

maria: The failing part is a flaky mac e2e that passed locally after a timeout bump. Steps I used: `git rebase main && ./scripts/run-smoke.sh` — I also bumped a timeout in `tests/mac/flaky.spec.js`.

ci-bot: CI queue pos=38. Estimated queue wait ~40m. flaky-suite: mac-e2e (intermittent timeout).

emily: I can approve the review right now (left a couple of small comments). If @jake rebases and links the build here I’ll give final thumbs. :thumbsup:

li: Ops note — there’s a deploy blackout 19:00–20:00 UTC tonight. If CI ETA pushes past 18:30 we should hold this for tomorrow morning to avoid collision.

jake: Okay starting a local rebase now. I’ll try to shorten the e2e by skipping the long perf checks for the smoke: `SKIP_PERF=1 ./scripts/run-smoke.sh`. Will push in ~10m.

maria: pushed a tiny timeout patch (increase from 5s→12s) and a comment explaining why. Diff: ```diff
- await page.waitForTimeout(5000)
+ // flaky on CI, timeout increased per infra ticket #452
+ await page.waitForTimeout(12000)
```

sam: If CI still queues high, we should consider the fallback: break PR into two smaller PRs and land the non-infra bits today. Otherwise schedule for the first slot tomorrow (09:00 UTC).

andrew: Fallback plan agreed. If canary fails we revert the test change and land only codegen parts in a follow-up (PR 27655). Keep the rollback ready.

jake: Rebase pushed — build queued (link: https://ci.internal/12345). Smoke passed locally with `SKIP_PERF=1`. Requesting fast-track merge when CI finishes. /assign me

emily: Approved. When CI finishes ping here and I'll merge if green. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks all — @jake ping here when the CI job is green. If we miss 18:30 hold per @li.

jake: Will do. Monitoring the queue now — ETA updated by CI: ~18m. Keeping fingers crossed. :crossed_fingers:
